title: How Rose came to know so many musicians
summary: Perhanis asks how he knew musicians personally. Rose says he never sought them out but knew some socially in New Orleans, then went to Temple University with a large record collection.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work
